messages:
Nadia (CSM): FYI — CareSync onboarding caused an embedding burst overnight. Renewal ~5w. Need 7-day spend forecast and a QBR-ready note for the account.
Jules (FinOps): pulling rough numbers. Any avg tokens/day and recent peak?
Rao (Onboarding): baseline 900k tokens/day. Last night peak ~4.5M after user import. Embeddings ~75% of total.
Lina (AE): customer anxious about surprise billing. Wants a predictable cap and a short explanation in the QBR.
Nadia (CSM): quick asks: 1) forecast scenarios 2) short-term guardrails we can apply 3) wording for customer nudge.
Jules (FinOps): Scenario A (no throttling): incremental ~ $6.5k over 7d. Scenario B (throttle + cache): ~ $1.8k. Using hosted standard pricing $0.0008/1k tokens.
Rao (Onboarding): I can enable per-route rate limits + enable dedupe cache. Quick config: route /v1/embeddings rate_limit 250rpm burst 60 cache_ttl 86400.
billing-bot: Alert: CareSync projected to hit 60% of monthly credit in 4 days.
Lina (AE): propose we offer a one-time onboarding credit $1k and set soft alert at 60%, hard cap at 85%. They get predictability and we buy time for renewal convo.
Nadia (CSM): suggested nudge: "Heads up — we detected a high-volume import. We've applied temporary throttling and added an onboarding credit to avoid bill shock. We'll review in your QBR"
Jules (FinOps): I'll finalize numbers and add two slides (baseline vs mitigated). Need approval for credit from finance.
Nadia (CSM): action items: @Jules finalize deck, @Rao apply limits + cache, @Lina confirm credit approval. Will draft QBR slide text.
Lina (AE): will follow up with finance today.
Rao (Onboarding): limits applied, token burn trending down.
Nadia (CSM): thanks team, closing unless numbers change.
